rhythm.pulse_description: Moderate, steady pulse supporting long lyrical phrases and gradual painterly transformations.
rhythm.meter_or_groove: Measured 4/4 folk-ballad pulse with restrained forward motion.

sections.name: Opening remembrance
musical_cues: First vocal phrases introduce fort, sea and remembered name
sections.visual_function: Awaken the tactile map and let embroidery spread through the remembered geography.

sections.name: Distance and origin
musical_cues: Vocal phrasing continues over a stable pulse
The lyric shifts from immediate remembrance toward distance and origin
sections.visual_function: Liquefy the map into sea and raise the island village from the painted current.

sections.name: Verse 3 expansion
musical_cues: The expanded verse increases narrative density
Place imagery broadens from island life toward memory and return
sections.visual_function: Transform village into fort and then soften the fort into the imagined homeland.

sections.name: Remembered presence
musical_cues: The pulse remains stable while the lyric turns toward face, voice and return
sections.visual_function: Let atmosphere overtake the homeland and reveal anonymous ancestral/personal presence in mist.

sections.name: Chorus crest
musical_cues: Mareas, caminos, piedras, mar and separation converge into the emotional crest
sections.visual_function: Reveal the complete tapestry, collapse its accumulated imagery inward and compress it into one luminous thread.

sections.name: Release to black
musical_cues: Final phrase resolves the separation motif
sections.visual_function: Allow the single thread to be caught by the unseen wind, carried away and vanish into pure black.

note: Lyrics are authoritative narrative input from the current user. The current-user Island Memory Tapestry storyboard remains locked visual canon; music and lyrics time and interpret that canon rather than replace it.
